subject: POC prompt dataset collection / evaluation plan - AcmeCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@acmecorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt dataset collection / evaluation plan - AcmeCorp

Hi Sanjay / Priya 

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff: 

Summary (1-line): Redwood will run a 4-week POC to validate generative assistant accuracy and latency on customer support prompts using a private deployment in your dev VPC.

Key success criteria (please confirm or edit):
- Intent-level accuracy >= 92% on prioritized ticket types (Billing, Account setup, Password reset)
- Latency (95th percentile) <= 400ms for 512-token requests under expected QPS
- No PII leakage reported in model outputs during trackable prompts

Evaluation plan / deliverables:
1) Customer provides 150-300 representative prompts (CSV) and ~50 red-team edge cases. We will run those through candidate models and baseline Redwood gen-configs.
2) Redwood returns model outputs, automated metrics (accuracy/ROUGE/EM as applicable), and a human review sheet for subjective quality (clarity, hallucination, correctness).
3) Weekly checkpoints (remote, 30 min)  Days 7, 14, 21, + final review on Day 28.

Timeline & ownership:
- Today (May 15): Redwood to share POC scope + prompt CSV template (attached).
- May 18: Acme to upload sample prompts + 3 example support threads / logs (anonymized). Owner: Priya.
- May 20-22: Redwood to run initial eval and share first-pass metrics. Owner: Marissa / Vivek.
- Week of May 24: Joint review and tuning; decision on final model variant for the trial.

Data sharing notes: please anonymize PII before sending. If you prefer, we can provide a secure file upload link / S3 presigned URL.

Attachments: acme_poc_scope.pdf (scope & eval template), acme_sample_prompts.csv (CSV template with columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, intent, expected_response), acme_logs_excerpt.txt (example log format).

Ask: Can you confirm the success criteria above and send the sample prompts and 3 anonymized threads by Tuesday (May 18)?

Thanks!


Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143
https://redwood.ai
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset collection / evaluation plan - AcmeCorp

Marissa  thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the criteria look good to us; a couple of clarifications: 

1) For accuracy: is the 92% target measured against our labeled intents only, or will Redwood apply fuzzy matching? We can provide gold labels for the 150 prompts.
2) For latency: the 400ms threshold is for end-to-end in our VPC or per-token server-side? We want to ensure we measure the same thing.

We will send the sample prompts and three anonymized threads by EOD Tuesday (May 18). Priya is coordinating the extraction  she may send from a shared mailbox.

We will attach a small logfile excerpt as well so you can see the typical request size distribution.

Sanjay
Sanjay Mehta
Director, Product Ops  AcmeCorp
Sanjay.Mehta@acmecorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@acmecorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset collection / evaluation plan - AcmeCorp

Sanjay  great, thanks. Quick answers: 
- Accuracy: we'll accept your gold labels (preferred). Redwood's automated matching will be configurable (exact, fuzzy, or intent classifier) and we'll note which method was used in the report.
- Latency: our P95 latency target is server-side inference time measured from request ingress to model response in your dev VPC (so excludes client-side network). We'll document the exact measurement points in the POC report.

As a reminder, anonymization checklist: remove email addresses, full names, and any payment identifiers. If you want, send one raw thread and we'll anonymize a copy and return it for your approval before using it in evals.

Next steps for Priya: please upload the CSV (use the attached template) and the three log/thread excerpts to the Drive link or reply-all with attachments. If easier, we can provide an S3 presigned URL  Vivek, can you share that by EOD today?

We'll schedule the Day 7 checkpoint for next Friday (May 21) at 10am PT  does that work for your team?

Thanks  looking forward to seeing the prompts.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
